description: Run configurations; F7 starts the default one.

default.description: The name of the configuration F7 starts.

configurations.description: The run configurations, each with a unique name.

name.description: The configuration's name, unique in the file.

command.description: The program to run, without a shell.

cwd.description: The folder to run in, from the project root. It must exist.

propertyNames.patternMessage: is not a valid environment variable name

preLaunchTask.description: A project task (F6) to run first; the run waits for it to succeed.

compound.description: Names of other configurations to start together and stop together, instead of a command.
